messages:
samira (ml-eng): Quick summary of KV cache quantization bakeoff (FP8 vs INT8) for a 30B LLM on dedicated GPUs. Results + artifacts: https://redwood.internal/run/kv-bake-223000

matt (infra): link works, saw the CI artifacts and perf graphs

samira (ml-eng): TL;DR: INT8-KV saves ~28% on KV table storage and ~12% end-to-end GPU memory. p50 latency down ~6ms, p95 down ~18ms. BUT observed a ~0.8% relative EM drop on the long-context QA eval (ctx > 8k).

jia (perf): Can you paste the perf table (absolute p50/p95 + mem)?

samira (ml-eng): Here are the main numbers from the harness (batch=4, seq varied 2k->8k, prefetch=on, evict_thresh=0.6):
```
FP8-KV: p50=34ms  p95=120ms  mem=24GB
INT8-KV: p50=28ms  p95=102ms  mem=21GB
Baseline (no-kv-quant): p50=36ms  p95=130ms  mem=27GB
```

oleg (research): The EM hit looks concentrated on entity extraction and some multi-step reasoning prompts. Any per-layer sensitivity?

samira (ml-eng): Did a quick layer-probe: largest deltas for INT8-KV are around the kv-projection and attention out-proj. AWQ probe suggests projection weights are sensitive to symmetric quantization noise.

ev an (sre): Any change in OOM/eviction behavior under load? Need to scope canary/regress alerts.

matt (infra): No new OOMs in the smoke runs (50k reqs), but eviction churn increased ~2.5x at peak concurrency. Prefetch stride and cache TTL look like good knobs. Also saw more small GC spikes during eviction bursts.

samira (ml-eng): Proposed rollout: canary 5% on Dedicated, route very long-context (>6k) traffic to FP8 fallback, monitor EM and p95 for 24h. Revert if EM delta > 0.5% absolute.

kv-test-bot: benchmark report uploaded: https://storage.redwood/kv-bake/223000/artifacts.tar.gz :thumbsup:

jia (perf): Let's also run hybrid configs: INT8 for KV storage, FP8 for projection matmuls; plus GPTQ/AWQ variants for only the projection layer. That might recover quality while keeping mem wins.

oleg (research): Will run layer-specific GPTQ and AWQ passes tomorrow (projection-only). I'll attach per-prompt deltas and confusion matrices.

samira (ml-eng): Great. I'll open a short RFC and a canary ticket with traffic rules + rollback alert (EM threshold).

matt (infra): Ack. I'll implement routing rule and add an alert on EM delta and p95 regression. Also will tune eviction_throttle and prefetch_stride as a mitigation.

samira (ml-eng): Action items: oleg/jia run projection probe (GPTQ/AWQ), samira create RFC+canary ticket, matt add alerts and tweak eviction/pretech knobs. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
